context: Request: every healthcare / life-sciences matter that turned on an FDA approval or clearance already granted, with supporting documents (experience list). Rubric: 1037-00003 (Solstice Biomedical, launch compliance review) and a document evidencing 510(k) clearance K232847, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review notes the listing is capped and recommends enumerating folders and a store-wide content search.
Counts and lists all matter folders (head and tail shown).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script over every document for request terms, printing up to six snippets per matching file; it times out after about 12M characters and the run ends.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: A store-wide extraction script with no output cap returned millions of characters and the run ended on a full context with no deliverable.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The store-wide extraction script printed millions of characters of snippets with no output cap; the result filled the context and the run ended before any answer was written.

divergence: All three runs failed the same way at the same stage: after a capped glob and a full folder listing, each ran a store-wide extraction script with broad terms and no output cap, whose multi-million-character result overflowed the context before any review or answer (critic: no-review in all three). The reviews before it had recommended exactly such a store-wide search without warning about output size.
